_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in Nigerian naira. The debt component, history and facts are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_nigeria.py from the DMO's quarterly Total Public Debt PDF; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Nigeria
title: Nigeria Debt Clock: Live Total Public Debt, Official Data
headline: total public debt
subject: The federal government, the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory of Nigeria
sum_note: Nigeria's total public debt (federal government, 36 states and the FCT; domestic and external), quarter-end, from the Debt Management Office. Gross, general government.
scope_note: This is the "Total Public Debt" that Nigeria's Debt Management Office (DMO) states for each quarter-end: the debt of the federal government plus the 36 state governments and the Federal Capital Territory, domestic and external, in naira. Unlike most pages in this series it is a wider measure than central government alone, because the DMO's headline number includes the states. The federal-government-only part is shown as a separate fact. Debt of government-owned companies is not included, and the figure is as the DMO states it, not adjusted here.
trend_why: We use the change over the latest twelve months rather than the last quarter because quarterly changes swing with the exchange rate (about a third of the debt is in foreign currency) and with issuance.
legend: Nigeria's public debt is reported quarterly, at quarter-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Quarterly. The DMO publishes each quarter-end position as a PDF about three months after the quarter ends.
after_text: , about three months after each quarter-end
next_update: The next quarter-end position (September 2026) is expected from the Debt Management Office roughly three months after the quarter ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: World Bank, World Development Indicators, Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), 2025, which is the UN World Population Prospects 2024 estimate
population.method_short: World Bank / UN World Population Prospects 2024 estimate for 2025 (Nigeria has not counted its population since 2006)

components.label: Nigeria total public debt
components.source_name: Debt Management Office of Nigeria, Total Public Debt as at quarter-end (PDF), N million
components.source_locator: PDF "Nigeria's Total Public Debt as at <date>", rows Total External Debt, Total Domestic Debt, Total Public Debt (A+B)
components.includes: Federal government, 36 states and the FCT: domestic and external debt in naira. Excludes the debt of government-owned companies.

facts.label: Federal government's own share of that total (domestic plus external)
facts.note: The "FGN Only" rows of the same DMO table: the federal government's debt without the states and the FCT.
facts.source_name: Debt Management Office of Nigeria, Total Public Debt

breakdown.label: External debt (federal, states and FCT; converted at the CBN official rate)

extra_sources.name: Federal Ministry of Finance, Budget Office and National Planning

notes: Why the DMO: it is the statutory manager of Nigeria's public debt and states the total itself, with the date and the exchange rate it used. The fetcher reads every quarter-end PDF from the last year and checks that domestic plus external equals the total.

Wider than central government: the DMO's headline total includes state governments and the FCT, so it is not like-for-like with a central-government-only page. The federal-government-only amount is shown as a fact.
Exchange rate: the DMO converts naira debt and dollar debt using the Central Bank's rate at the date; the naira figures here are as stated in naira.

Currency: Nigerian naira. The World Debt Clock converts it to US dollars at the US Treasury's Reporting Rates of Exchange (a quarterly official rate as of 30 September 2026; the page for the World Debt Clock shows the rate and its date).
world_measure: Total public debt (federal, states and FCT)
